scope: Complete the five missing pose candidates around the published unmasked pre-injury Lute READY. Two ordinary arms in every pose; historical portrait and animation atlases are not edited by this batch.

referencePolicy.primary: Published Lute READY is supplied unchanged to every generation call as the identity, proportions and style reference.
referencePolicy.numericSeed: The built-in tool exposes no numeric seed; consistency uses the same reference image.
referencePolicy.officialCorroboration: The licensed Youtooz illustration was inspected for the white bob, yellow eyes, black halo, gray exorcist uniform, two normal gray-gloved arms and striped wings. Its toy proportions, sword and blood marks were not adopted.
referencePolicy.historicalPortrait: The old portrait/atlases with a golden arm are outside this costume and were not used as generation inputs.

sources.role: Primary image input to all five calls; existing files reused without copy or modification.

sources.copyright: Amazon Content Services LLC / A24 Films LLC
sources.role: Visual corroboration; not a series production model sheet and not supplied to the five pose-generation calls.
Published READY prompt, provenance, continuity correction and original technical checks.

exportPolicy.masters: Original generated PNG files copied byte-for-byte, originals retained.
exportPolicy.runtime: Pillow WebP lossless=True, exact=True, quality=100, method=6; dimensions, all decoded RGBA bytes and alpha retained.

layoutPolicy.note: Generative framing is not pixel-normalized. Some halo/boot margins remain narrow; native low-alpha fringe is preserved. Runtime scale, feet, mirroring and transitions require a dedicated check.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-character-edit / identity-preserve pose variant. Create exactly ONE full-body 2D game sprite of Lute from Hazbin Hotel, the SAME unmasked Season 1 pre-injury character shown in the supplied published READY sprite. Treat this image as the authority for proportions, face, palette, line art, clothing, halo and wings. Preserve her tall slender adult build and long legs, sharp asymmetrical white bob with pale lavender shading, pale gray face, yellow eyes with black pupils and long black eyelashes, black ring halo pierced by the narrow vertical pointed ornament, short charcoal-gray exorcist tunic, pale frilled collar, pale bands on dark short sleeves, pale belt, opaque black fitted leggings, matching light-gray elbow-length gloves, very tall pointed light-gray boots with dark chevron trim, and pale wings with thick dark edges and exactly TWO transverse dark stripes. Both arms are intact ordinary arms with matching gloves. No prosthesis, no gold arm, no mask, no horns, no new costume or accessories. Keep the same clean crisp flat 2D cel-shaded drawing style and controlled outline thickness. Image is a single pose sprite, not an illustration scene or a panel. Facing and looking toward the RIGHT edge in a readable three-quarter side view. Preserve all clothing coverage and keep the entire halo, both wings, both hands and both feet visible. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Keep the same body scale as the reference, an approximately central horizontal body pivot, and consistent ground baseline near y=1480 for grounded poses. Leave clear transparent padding around every extremity and fold the wings naturally when needed to fit; do not clip or duplicate limbs. Fully transparent background including gaps between feathers, with crisp native alpha. No surrounding glow, floor, cast shadow, border, text, logo, opponent, separate object or VFX.

POSE — STRIKE: a controlled short unarmed forward palm strike toward the RIGHT, the front arm extended at shoulder/chest height with the palm facing outward, the other forearm bent close to the torso in guard. Weight shifts to the forward foot while both feet remain grounded, rear heel only slightly lifted. Head and gaze track right. Wings stay folded behind the shoulders so that the attacking hand is unobstructed. This is a single clear contact key pose, with no impact target or motion trail.

visualQa.poseDescription: Controlled forward open-palm strike to the right; other hand in compact guard.

alignmentObservation.note: Alpha-bound measurement only, not a normalized animation pivot. Jump is intentionally airborne; crouch retains empty headroom. No crop, resize or pixel shift was applied.
